knowledgeUnits.applicabilityTrigger: Any client or server numeric calculation helper performing division or decimal addition.
verificationAssertions: Division by 0 must return explicit error token instead of Infinity

knowledgeUnits.patternName: Atomic Redis Lua Compare-And-Swap Token Rotation with Bounded Grace Window
knowledgeUnits.applicabilityTrigger: Distributed session, OAuth2 refresh token, or one-time nonce rotation subject to multi-tab network bursts.
knowledgeUnits.reusableAstTemplate: redis.eval(ATOMIC_ROTATE_LUA, { keys: [familyKey], arguments: [incomingJti, nextJti, nowMs, graceMs] })
verificationAssertions: Simultaneous burst with identical JTI returns 1 ROTATED_NEW + N-1 GRACE_WINDOW_REPLAY
Ancestor token reuse outside grace window sets revoked=1 on entire family

knowledgeUnits.patternName: Serializable Pessimistic Row-Lock + Idempotent Mutation Pattern
knowledgeUnits.applicabilityTrigger: Any financial or inventory balance mutation endpoint where concurrent requests could violate a non-negative balance invariant.
knowledgeUnits.reusableAstTemplate: prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => { await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`; ... }, { isolationLevel: Serializable })
verificationAssertions: Parallel Promise.allSettled race probe must reject second over-balance request
Duplicate Idempotency-Key must return IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY without side effects
